citation.title: Modeling and control of plasma rotation for NSTX using neoclassical toroidal viscosity and neutral beam injection
citation.authors: Goumiri I.R., Rowley C.W., Sabbagh S.A., Gates D.A., Gerhardt S.P., Boyer M.D., Andre R., Kolemen E., Taira K.

topic: Model-based feedback control of NSTX toroidal rotation profile using NBI and NTV actuators, tested on a reduced model and TRANSP predictive simulations
own_question: Can a low-order momentum-transport model linearized in a Bessel basis support LQG/integral control of the rotation profile under actuator constraints?
actual_method_and_evidence: Simplified 1D momentum diffusion PDE with coefficients fitted from TRANSP analysis of NSTX discharges. Reduced to a few Bessel modes. Uses an LQR controller with a Kalman observer from two rotation sensor points, plus integral anti-windup and PWM beams. Evidence is simulation only (reduced model and TRANSP). There is no KSTAR, BES/ECEI or temperature nowcasting, and no experimental closed-loop result.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Rotation-profile control has been explored in model-based simulation using observers that reconstruct profiles from a few rotation measurements.
claim_checks.qualification: The paper reports NSTX simulations only, using TRANSP predictive runs. It targets rotation, not impurity CES temperature, and does not demonstrate real-time deployment.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Inputs are model states and two rotation sensor outputs. Real-time measurement is referenced to other work. Report arrival timing is not addressed.
validation_if_relevant: Model is fitted to discharge 133367 and compared with TRANSP for other discharges. The authors report relative errors up to about 30%. There is no held-out experimental control test.
forbidden_inferences: Do not cite it as evidence for CES temperature nowcasting or for BES/ECEI information.
Do not claim it shows experimental closed-loop rotation control.
Do not generalize it to all prior profile-control work.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Only tangential: it is control-oriented profile modeling with an observer. It is optional as one background example of downstream uses of kinetic profiles. It does not support our estimation framing.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
